positions.description:
In this project we developed a communication strategy for the launch of a ‘digital first-aid button' for a children's rights organisation. 

The project included:
• Identification of core target groups based on a quantitative analysis
• Execution of interviews with decision-makers from the target groups and research on their media use
• Derivation of recommendations on top-down and bottom-up approach to reach the target groups
• Development and design of a Plan Book containing insights on target groups and respective promotional activities

180 Degrees Consulting Munich is part of the world‘s largest university-based consultancy. 
In this project we successfully derived a customer tailored product portfolio for an IT service provider based in Ghana. This project included:

• Assessment of competitive environment and unique selling proposition (USP)
• Execution of follow-up meetings to substantiate survey findings and evaluate potential for cooperation

company.name: Center for Digital Technology and Management (CDTM)
company.tagline: Connect, Educate and Empower the Innovators of Tomorrow
company.description:
The Center for Digital Technology and Management (CDTM), a joint institution of the Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität München (LMU) and the Technische Universität München (TUM), offers talented students the international and interdisciplinary study program Technology Management. 

The CDTM focuses on how to manage High-Tech in close cooperation with industry, research and education, while simultaneously being committed to preparing the students for future leadership positions in their professional career.
